description.describe_eh: The course contains introduction of composition, analysis and representation with special research topics and operating principles of the seminar, training of a talk representation with special topics of the graduate student, training to writing and analysis of the special topics work.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能用專業定理應用於碩士論文研究中，執行與驗證各項專業定理，其中包括資料的蒐集、維護、管理與理論的測試。
courseBankC.describe_en: When can apply to study in master's thesis the theorem, carry out and verify every theorem, including the collection, maintenance, test of management and theory of the materials.
courseBankC.core_item: 蒐集資料、規範問題、加以分析驗證獲得結論，並有撰寫專業論文之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to collect data, standardize and analyze problem to obtain conclusion and write professional papers.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明各項碩士論文研究之方法與進行程序。
courseBankC.describe_en: Method that can understand and prove that the master studies thesis and carrying on the procedure.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備機械專業領域自我學習、創新思考及持續發展之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability of self-learning, innovative thinking and sustainable development in mechanical engineering.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 透過對文獻閱讀後的口頭發表，不同領域的同學間能有效溝通
courseBankC.core_item: 跨領域有效溝通、清晰表達、領導管理、團隊合作分工及規劃統整之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to communicate effectively across domains, express clearly, collaborate and plan with team.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 閱讀最新的文獻掌握最新趨勢
courseBankC.core_item: 具備掌握國際機械發展趨勢及對於環境永續、社會共好與全球發展的影響，培養技術接軌之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Understand the trend of international machinery development and its impact on environmental sustainability, social common good and global development. In addition, cultivate the ability to integrate technology.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 從論文題目的搜尋，確認其節能減碳的效益。
courseBankC.core_item: 具備評估綠色產品、永續發展及研究成果，以解決複雜且整合性工程問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to evaluate green products, sustainable development and research results to solve complex and integrated engineering problems.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 利用小組討論文獻，理解成員的權利、義務
courseBankC.core_item: 理解專業與資訊倫理及社會責任。
courseBankC.core_eng: Understand professional and information ethics and social responsibility.
